converter: cth_convert_sym_v7.py (a copy of docx_text() of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.previous_converter: harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-10-13 deposit
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word file of C2015C00461 (C2015C00461.docx, sha256 7a729a70347d8b108f4b71a6a0c6ff0981346e40cd5e505bb8ca51279f2726d8, this deposit's download_sha256)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() dropped characters Word writes as Symbol-font w:sym elements. cth_convert_sym_v7.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0B1 ±, F02A * and the like), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: Two characters restored in the lists of substances annexed to the Convention on Psychotropic Substances (the Schedule): line 428, the plus-minus sign (Symbol F0B1 -> ±) of the racemic amphetamine, "()-2-amino-1-phenylpropane" -> "(±)-2-amino-1-phenylpropane"; line 389, the asterisk note mark (Symbol F02A -> *) of the heading "LISTS OF SUBSTANCES IN THE SCHEDULES*". A diff against the first deposit shows no other change (same lines). The footnote that asterisk points to (on the names printed in capitals, the INNs) is a Word footnote, which neither converter reads, so it is still not in the deposit.
